notes: SHIP v1.14.436 - ONE MODE, ONE BUILD. THE ROUTING DEFECT BEHIND THE INCOHERENT TECHNICIAN FLOW. WHAT WAS WRONG, MEASURED BY WALKING THE APP AS A TECHNICIAN. Home primary CTA - the control a DCT taps to start a shift - called cmd_route work/deploy, which runs showWorkTab(deploy): that calls showMode(work) and then DRILLS PAST the Build workspace into the deploy Command Center list. The BUILD tab calls showMode(work) and stops. Measured: nav BUILD gives bw-shell alone; Home CTA gave bw-shell PLUS wk-deploy. ONE MODE RENDERING TWO DIFFERENT BUILDS depending on which door you came through - and the door a technician uses to begin work was the one that landed somewhere else. WHY THE OLD ROUTE WAS RIGHT WHEN IT WAS WRITTEN. The v1.14.121 chokepoint deliberately routes every deploy entry past the bare Open Deploy launcher stub and onto the Command Center list. That was the best destination available, because there was no Build workspace. v1.14.385 built one: current rack, current phase, next action, blockers, contextual tools, contextual scan, open aisle. Pick up where the build left off now has a real answer and a deployment LIST is not it. THE FIX. cmd_continueWork() is a named destination rather than a synonym for the deploy list, and the three CONTINUE-WORK CTAs point at it: the Home hero CTA, the RESUME signal (Continue seeding racks) and the Next Best Action card (Pick up where the build left off). It fails loudly per Contract 14 - logErr plus toast - never silently. ⛔ ONLY THOSE THREE MOVED. The Deploy tile, the desktop sidebar Deploy item and the in-Build deploy button genuinely mean manage deployments, and the list is the correct destination for them. They are untouched and pinned as untouched. INTENT DECIDES THE DOOR, NOT THE WORD DEPLOY APPEARING IN A LABEL - rewriting them would have been churn dressed as a workflow fix. WHAT THE WALK ALSO ESTABLISHED, recorded so it is not re-investigated: BUILD is ALREADY the canonical technician surface - the walk found current rack, current phase, next action, Log blocker, contextual Port map/BOM/Manifest/Rack map, contextual Scan, Open aisle, Complete NETWORK. The workspace was never the problem; what routed into it was. SCAN is not missing a door either - pg-scan is re-parented into wk-scan at boot, so it is already contextual inside Build exactly as the canonical flow specifies. TWO THINGS DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED. The tool tiles stay: rd_openOpsTool has 2-4 entry points per tool but all route through the ONE canonical door, which Contract A2 explicitly permits, and collapsing them would cost taps in the aisle. The aisle header keeps its provenance line: site, filename, LOADED or RESTORED FROM CACHE reads like machinery but is data honesty with a track record - RESTORED FROM CACHE is the string that cracked the .424 P0. TESTS: new spec 25-continue-work, five tests - the two doors now land on the SAME surface (the assertion that was [] versus [wk-deploy] before), the Home CTA is wired to continue-work, the manage-deployments doors are UNTOUCHED, the deploy list is still reachable and still works, and continue-work fails loudly. 25: 5 passed. 01-nav plus 06-composition: 26 passed. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, CSS braces balanced, CRLF intact, three-stamp lockstep. No CSS change, no renderer change - renderer consolidation remains stopped per owner directive. DEVICE-VERIFY: from HOME tap the primary CTA. You must land on the BUILD WORKSPACE - current rack, current phase, next action - and NOT on a deployment list. Then tap the BUILD tab: identical surface. The Deploy tile on Home should still open the deployment list, because that is what it is for.
